Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows two pulmonary nodules (indicated by arrows), one in the right middle lobe region and another retrocardiac on the left. In the context of DIPNECH (Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia), nodules larger than 5 mm are classified as carcinoid tumors, whereas those smaller than 5 mm are tumorlets; the visible size and clinical association point to carcinoids.
